system.description: Despite its name, this gold-spangled crystal cabochon works for any Exalt. When its bearer places the beacon to her forehead and expends a mote of Essence, her caste mark blazes and projects a beam of light for the rest of the scene. In conditions of less than perfect lighting, this beam provides clear vision to a range of 15 yards, and (if necessary) murky vision out to 30 yards. However, the narrow beam illuminates an area only 5 yards wide at the end of clear vision, or 10 yards wide at the end of murky vision.
